The context

Sharing a file should involve thinking about where its contents and keys travel. This prototype explores that boundary with encryption in the browser.

The approach

  • Implemented browser-side AES-256-GCM encryption for files and filenames.
  • Used S3 presigned URLs for direct uploads and downloads.
  • Passed decryption keys in URL fragments and implemented expiry and download-limit checks.

What came out of it

A documented prototype joining client-side cryptography with a cloud storage workflow.

Scope & limitations

Educational prototype; no independent cryptographic audit or production-readiness claim. Sharing a complete link also shares access to its key.
